rows.review: Records separate index, native display time and exact datetime; Candle frozen, Candidate mutable, Reset/analysis/result frozen but nested lists not. Native doji GREEN via Open<=Close. Base retains sequence references and shared indexes; actual first two main times or 1 second duration, rejects nonpositive. Time index body at 175–182 is outside row, linked separately.

rows.review: Lower windows half-open, owner mapping upper bound minus one within selected position range and timestamp before next actual open/last+TF. Main extrema inclusive, switch indexed at difference>=16, reflected sequence queries original opposite extreme and exact copy_negate; strict improvements preserve first tie. Preceding GREEN run requires immediate previous GREEN, bounded by detector start.
rows.handoff: Shared index earliest tie and main_source_for_time selected-owner predicate are distinct from MarketChronology.main_index clamp.

rows.review: Breakout start truthy intrabar_start else top source+1 when earlier than First, else top source; end Break+TF exclusive. Strict first crossing and min prefix through crossing inclusive; missing source owner/null crossing null. Mode A boundary anchor if nonnull else leg floor. Main equality preserves; both main predicates use lower position with invalidation <= breakout; neither evidence invalidates. Confirmed Reset race analogous but different initial guards. Post-confirmation begins event+1us, no substitute main crossing.
rows.handoff: Blue uses default confirmation accessor, not this analysis result; reset record may have exact or absent second time.

rows.review: Standalone scan restores initial cursor subset only, copies candidate. Strict confirmed Reset checked before candidate, clears state and records owner First; invalidation clears candidate without Reset. Opposite edge strictly updated then Break. first_only returns immediately after append before remainder Reset. Otherwise post-reset records exact lower display, resets leg state; RED Break seeds B from full main values without requiring exact analysis.
rows.handoff: Standalone helper first_only and Unified normal successor differ; don't import standalone remainder policy into Unified.

rows.review: New leg freezes Low; RED after GREEN reset and Low>=reset Low opens A, preceding GREEN peak wins equality. Subsequent GREEN→RED gate clears invalidation anchor only when previous and current lows both strictly below it; candidate checks anchor floor else prior/leg floor. Failed RED replaces anchor, DOJI/NEUTRAL tag clears (native doji GREEN). Mode B running peak wins equal; update strictly. Retain initial cursor only when requested on exhaustion.
rows.handoff: First-color and reset context semantics precede published geometry; no market doji reclassification.

rows.review: Reflect price via copy_negate and exchange high/low and role tags; preserve time/index/display and non-GREEN/RED tags. Candidate replacement swaps box source and prices, optional anchor/leg prices; other fields including metadata retained. Sequence cache exact identity, per-position cached reflected rows, no refresh in view itself. Bearish reference shares original times and reflected index, returned Reset level negated.
rows.handoff: Role reflection not public candle color; cache correctness conditional on sequence lifetime/immutability.

rows.review: Presentation clone, missing Break or invalid bounds returns unchanged before direction validation. Clip only if opposite source==Break, seed First main then strict pre-Break extrema, scan lower Break open to end and update opposite before same-row confirmation; absent strict hit returns clone. First==Break seeds full main extreme, so clipping is not universal.
rows.handoff: Public clone and native canonical append are separate; behavior containment uses published box, not rewritten native geometry.

rows.review: Mode A scan from anchor else First-1 clamped stage start; extend backward through correct context tag, strict main outer extrema through Break inclusive. Mode non-A requires reaction_number>1, previous ordinal−2 semantic outer edge and stored source, no re-extremization or internal/healthy flag check here. Source time main timestamp.
rows.handoff: S/E common stop provider; independent number zero can enter Mode A but non-A zero raises. Stop level/source are not confirmation or strict crossing.

rows.review: LiveBehavior validates dirty range. Reuse entry only same ordinal geometry tuple incl string prices and Break<dirty; recompute otherwise. Changed positions by full entry inequality; retain surviving unchanged pairs, recompute changed inner vs all outer or unchanged inner vs changed outer, supports multiple owners. Reapply mutable metadata, commit cache after successful application, no rollback of mutations.
rows.handoff: Optional behavior service, not active public live worker by mere existence; Blue internal flag is monotone on retained object.

rows.review: Bounded fallback A-stop closure validates exact direction and uses key (gate_index,end_index) ignoring gate_event; first adjacent role transition from max(1,gate), context expands backward to 0; cache candidate tuple from Unified detection with First threshold, returns cached object reference, not clone. Unified stores output direction without local validation, lazy direction helpers, per-direction ledgers and distinct caches.
rows.handoff: A-stop consumer applies exact initial confirmation threshold later; fallback closure ignores exact event by design, not universal direct geometry service.

rows.review: Conditional opposite reference recomputation from last Reset to candidate First when Break exists and adjacent anchor. Exact opposite Break==anchor match; bullish anchor low>=First low replaces top, bearish anchor high<=First high replaces bottom. No explicit check replacement extends prior candidate edge, so comment about never shrinking is not a predicate.
rows.handoff: Actual boundary assignment, not guarantee of monotonic box extension; canonical confirmation edge separate from opposite recomputation.

rows.review: If Break nonnull recalc opposite main extrema First..Break inclusive; if Break owns extreme and analysis available replace with exact analysis extreme/source, otherwise preserve full-main result. Mutates supplied candidate before shallow replacement append; null Break still appended. Always returns true in shown implementation.
rows.handoff: Ledger snapshot and caller object geometry may differ from earlier local analysis; downstream stop uses canonical source, not a pure public clone.

rows.review: Append main index/display, nullable second display, supplied broken level and originating First; no recovery, normalization or dedup in helper.
rows.handoff: Blue/Order_B/S use separate downstream exact event resolution; ordinary dedup is caller-side.

rows.review: Refine only opposite edge whose source is current candle and analysis nonnull; returns analysis even if no refinement. Unified same-Break successor requires correct main tag and exact analysis; strict post-confirmation breach rejects. Then uses entire Break lower rows; High max key uses negative timestamp.timestamp() epoch FLOAT, Low min uses datetime, first full-key tie. Return B with both main sources and intrabar_start main open; confirmed argument unused.
rows.handoff: Separate geometry ownership phases; don't claim exact datetime tie for high when epoch float collapses distinct instants.

rows.review: Retained route asserts expected cursor type and uses reflected reference for ordinary bearish, mirrors result once. Trend isolated bootstrap first boundary candle can be First; before First strict fixed confirmation-side improvement; no prior boundary invalidation. Continue after creation, cannot confirm same First. Opposite edge strict update before Break; refine; exhaustion saves trend cursor if requested; empty window returns before save.
rows.handoff: Reversal independent segment flags select initial bootstrap; loop position vs Candle.index may differ for noncoherent custom inputs.

rows.review: Normal post-Reset First search strictly after Reset and beyond blocked_through; proper colors and builder. Confirmed result returns in First traversal order, earlier unresolved candidate sets pending and allows later candidates; invalidation blocks through its main, exhaustion returns null,true. Geometry-only scan ignores invalidation; cache lookup with copy on hit, no write in method; first complete in First traversal order.
rows.handoff: Do not conflate ordinary search, permissive geometry, or concurrent Order geometry; raw completed geometry not accepted physical Order.

rows.review: Break list cache by direction and ledger length; no sort or duplicate check. Gate valid start<=gate<limit; key direction/gate/limit/exact event, FIFO bounded copy cache. Bisect_left selects prior owner or first equal Break if local confirmation<=gate; local intrabar start un-clamped, fallback main open. No owner sets no-history; otherwise outer extent First..max(First,gate−1), gate opposite edge. Lower search half-open; outward wins equal position; restart owning main+1, continue gate+1. Reconstruct missing anchor index OR value from max prior Reset strictly before new First, assigns all three fields.
rows.handoff: Caller order/unique Break invariants are not enforced; E/Order consumer canonical identity and decision gates separate.

rows.review: Concurrent candidates start from first allowed color transition after reset bound. Reject invalidation before mutation; earliest confirming MAIN wins, smallest First within same main, not sort by exact lower times. Builder context and prior First-color runs bounded by reset; local strict First floor/ceiling, frozen outer anchor Reset..First−1. Outer invalidation race checks lower outward first, no evidence defaults invalidation. Geometry scan returns candidate, no append.
rows.handoff: Order_A/E need their own canonical identity and owner-stop gate; strict invalidation and geometry-only relaxation distinct.

rows.handoff: Threshold is First index gate, not confirmation horizon, and not a complete lifecycle run.

Post-confirmation Reset appends exact display and pending index; else shared remainder seed. Return scan cursor.

Duplicate suppressed only by last Reset owner First equality.

findings.detail: Commentary in RE76 about never shrinking is not enforced by an explicit monotonic comparison; actual adjacent-anchor assignment and canonical recomputation documented. No production defect asserted.
High tie uses native epoch float in same-Break successor; original CP323-S12 wording about earliest timestamp must be qualified by float key. Detailed RE79 already records this.
CP323-S01 stops at shared time-index declaration; add body link. P07/P08 and P08/P09 split at state/constructor boundaries; preserve original IDs and link adjacent rows.

Order gate main-break list cache assumes caller order/length; no universal guarantee of unique exact confirmations. Direct normal, permissive geometry and concurrent Order search have different ordering and invalidation. Existing RE84–RE94 precise.
